label: sound
instruction_covers: Base install includes distro and drops the singledispatch==3.4.0.3 pin
Packaged and static requirement sets pin distro==1.5.0, including Windows
Windows resolution keeps pymssql==2.1.4 only for Python older than 3.8
Files and generation follow existing packaging conventions
notes: Hidden tests read requirements/base.txt, pkg/*/req.txt, and requirements/static/py*/{darwin,linux,windows}.txt. Those paths exist (pkg/osx/req.txt, pkg/windows/req.txt, static py3.5-py3.9 darwin/linux, windows only through py3.7). pip-compile headers in the static files name the inputs, so updating base.txt and pkg/*/req.txt and regenerating is the repo workflow the instruction points at. Marker evaluation for 3.7 vs 3.8/3.9 matches the stated version split; pyzmq in pkg/windows/req.txt is the sibling marker pattern. No extra pin, filename, or message is required.
